name: Privatzimmer Sieberer
beschreibung: The Privatzimmer Sieberer is a traditional inn in the center of Kufstein. Its location offers a view of the fortress and is within immediate proximity to the pedestrian zone. Guests can expect cozy rooms with traditional furnishings and a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The establishment is family-run, and the atmosphere is quiet and inviting. Ideal for travelers seeking Tiroler hospitality without a mass-tourism setting.
